name: desidata
description: Search and preview DesiData's published India-focused dataset catalogue.

interface.longDescription: Search DesiData's published India-focused dataset catalogue, inspect dataset details and source links, preview a small sample, and get notebook or Python loader examples. Search and previews work without signing in. Full dataset downloads use the user's own DesiData DD_TOKEN through the normal DesiData download flow.
capabilities: Get notebook links and Python loader examples
defaultPrompt: Use DesiData to search published India-focused datasets. Show the source, licence, row count, and a small preview when useful.

positive.description: Search the published catalogue for a topic
positive.prompt: Find published DesiData datasets about the Indian census.
positive.expected_behavior: Return matching published dataset records with available source, licence, row count, and dataset links. Do not claim to search inside CSV contents.

positive.description: Inspect provenance for a matching dataset
positive.prompt: Find a published Indian census dataset and show its source, licence, row count, and details page.
positive.expected_behavior: Identify a matching published dataset and report only the metadata returned by DesiData, clearly noting fields that are missing. Include the source and dataset page links when available.

positive.prompt: Find a published CSV dataset about the Indian census and show me a small sample.
positive.expected_behavior: Find a published CSV dataset, then return only the bounded preview provided by DesiData (up to 10 rows and 12 columns). Do not return or imply that the full CSV was downloaded.

positive.description: Get a notebook link for a published dataset
positive.prompt: Find a published Indian census dataset and give me its DesiData notebook link.
positive.expected_behavior: Find a matching published dataset and return its notebook URL and dataset page URL. Do not claim to generate or attach a notebook file.

positive.description: Get Python loader code without exposing credentials
positive.prompt: Find a published Indian census dataset and show me Python code to load it with DesiData.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the package installation command and loader example for the published dataset slug. Explain that the user configures their own DD_TOKEN privately; never request or expose a token value.

negative.description: Do not send a full dataset through chat
negative.prompt: Download and paste the complete CSV for the Indian census dataset into this chat.

negative.description: Do not expose unpublished catalogue records
negative.prompt: Show me DesiData's unpublished or draft datasets, including private upload details.

negative.description: Do not change a dataset's licence or catalogue record
negative.prompt: Change the licence on this dataset to MIT and publish the update.

review.commerce_description: DesiData is a dataset discovery service. This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Version 0.2.0: use DesiData's branded MCP domain, add the Terms of Service URL, and provide review test cases.
